#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdint>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;
vector<long long> fac, invfac;

long long power(long long x, long long y, long long p) {
    long long res = 1LL;
    x = x % p;
    while (y > 0) {
        if (y & 1LL)
            res = (res * x) % p;
        y >>= 1;
        x = (x * x) % p;
    }
    return res;
}

long long nCr(int a, int b) {
    long long res = fac[b];
    res = (res * invfac[a]) % MOD;
    res = (res * invfac[b - a]) % MOD;
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int N;
    long long lmao;
    cin >> N >> lmao;
    
    if (lmao >= N) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    
    int K = (int)lmao;
    int C = N - K;
    
    const int MAXF = 200001;
    fac.resize(MAXF);
    invfac.resize(MAXF);
    fac[0] = 1;
    invfac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < MAXF; ++i) {
        fac[i] = (fac[i-1] * i) % MOD;
        invfac[i] = power(fac[i], MOD - 2, MOD);
    }
    
    long long res = power(C, N, MOD);
    for (int e = 1; e < C; ++e) {
        long long temp = power(C - e, N, MOD);
        temp = (temp * nCr(e, C)) % MOD;
        if (e % 2 == 1)
            res = (res - temp + MOD) % MOD;
        else
            res = (res + temp) % MOD;
    }
    res = (res * nCr(C, N)) % MOD;
    if (K > 0)
        res = (2LL * res) % MOD;
    
    cout << res << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
